title: Accounts Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and motivated Accounts Executive to join our Accounts \& Finance team. The ideal candidate should possess basic accounting knowledge, good analytical skills, and the ability to manage daily accounting activities efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain day\-to\-day accounting transactions and records.
* Handle purchase entries, sales entries, receipts, and payment vouchers.
* Assist in preparing invoices, bills, and financial reports.
* Reconcile bank statements and ledger accounts.
* Support GST filing, TDS, and other statutory compliance activities.
* Maintain proper documentation and filing of financial records.
* Coordinate with internal departments regarding payment and account\-related matters.
* Assist during audits and financial reviews.
* Ensure accuracy and confidentiality of financial information.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
* Familiarity with Tally, MS Excel, and accounting software.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or related field (B.Com preferred).

Preferred Qualifications

* Internship or prior experience in accounting will be an added advantage.
* Basic understanding of GST and taxation processes.

Salary

* Best in industry, based on skills and experience.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Accounting: 2 years (Required)

Location:

* Kochi, Kerala (Required)

Work Location: In person

Description:
**About IHCL**
--------------


Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) is a part of the Tata Group and is one of South Asia's largest and most iconic hospitality companies. With a legacy of over 120 years, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to our guests through our diverse portfolio of hotels, resorts, and palaces.


**Careers at IHCL**
-------------------


At IHCL, we believe our employees are our greatest asset. We are committed to fostering a dynamic work environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. Join us in creating memorable experiences and shaping the future of hospitality. Explore exciting career opportunities with us and be a part of a vibrant team that values passion, excellence, and diversity.


**Job Objective**
-----------------


To provide the revenue figures necessary for determining the individual profit center's profitability, which includes reconciling and monitoring revenue records and following internal procedures to ensure the company complies with all tax obligations.


**Essential Job Tasks**
-----------------------


Ensure that all revenue transactions, such as room revenue, food and beverage sales, and other services, are accurate and recorded in the accounting system, and create daily and monthly sales reports, as well as financial statements, for management.


**Areas of Responsibility**
---------------------------


* Properly check and finalize the daily room revenue report.


* Ensure market segmentation correctly reflects the source of business and is accurately reflected in the GL.


* Verify the room rate with agreements or reservations, check allowance for room revenue, and ensure room revenue as per PMS is corrected in the GL.


* Check the rebate report, discount report, complimentary and house use report, no\-show postings, late check\-outs, etc., to ensure that every complimentary room, house\-use room, discount, or rebate of revenue has adequate explanation in the approval form.


* Prepare monthly reports and schedules as part of the monthly MIS pack and financials.


* Prepare the DSR on a daily basis.


* Ensure control to report any discrepancies between housekeeping and front office room status. The total rooms available for sale should agree with the contracted rooms available


**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


B Com/Mcom degree in Finance


**Work Experience**
-------------------


1\-2 Years


**Languages Needed in Position**
--------------------------------


English


**Key Interfaces\- External**
-----------------------------


Consultants


**Key Interfaces\- Internal**
-----------------------------


Finance functions and compliances


**Behavioural Competencies**
----------------------------


Process Excellence
Result Orientation
Collaborative Engagement
Change Championship
Growth Mindset
Guest Centricity
Personal Effectiveness

------------------------------------------


At IHCL, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team, where every voice is valued and respected.

title: Accountant
description:
ACCOUNTS EXECUTIVE

**Company:** K\-LAM Agency – Lamination Depot  
**Location:** Elamakkara, Punnakkal, Kochi, Kerala  
**Experience:** 1–2 Years  
**Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com  
**Department:** Accounts \& Billing

Job Responsibilities

* Handle day\-to\-day accounting and billing activities.
* Prepare customer invoices, sales bills and purchase bills.
* Prepare and maintain **GST invoices** and basic GST\-related records.
* Manage sales and purchase entries in accounting software.
* Handle cash, bank and daily transaction entries.
* Maintain customer/dealer outstanding and payment records.
* Verify bills, vouchers and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with customers regarding billing and payment follow\-ups.
* Maintain proper records of accounts and documentation.
* Assist in monthly accounting, GST filing data preparation and reconciliation.
* Support the management with basic accounts reports and statements.

Requirements

* B.Com / M.Com qualification.
* **1–2 years of experience in Accounts \& Billing.**
* Good knowledge of **GST billing and basic accounting**.
* Knowledge of Tally / accounting software preferred.
* Good MS Excel and computer skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle day\-to\-day accounts independently.
* Candidates from **Elamakkara, Punnakkal and nearby areas of Kochi** preferred.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1737527
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Job title : Staff**

  


**Job purpose**

  



This position is responsible for assisting the Record to Report (R2R) team with various accounting processes, including


* Journal Entry Processing
* Account Reconciliations
* Financial Reporting Support

  


**Responsibilities**

  


* Support Record to Report (R2R) activities, including journal entry processing, account reconciliation, and financial reporting.
* Ensure compliance with local statutory requirements and accounting guidelines to prevent errors and compliance issues during processing.
* Adhere to defined processes and timelines for reports and schedules, ensuring timely delivery.
* Update and maintain dashboards to track the progress of R2R activities and the status of multi\-country engagements.
* Provide prompt and comprehensive responses to queries from clients and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiencies.
* Participate in training sessions and workshops to enhance knowledge and skills related to R2R processes.

  


**Functional \& Technical skills**

  


* Experience in Record to Report (R2R) processes, with expertise in at least one of the following areas:
* + Journal entry processing
	+ Account reconciliations
	+ Financial reporting support
* Experience in process transition and adaptation to new systems or tools.
* Basic knowledge of accounting processes.
* Knowledge of accounting principles (IFRS, US GAAP) is an added advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office packages.
* Experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft D365 or SAP (or similar financial systems).
* Strong organizational skills, initiative, and commitment to quality work
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Motivated self\-starter with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.

  


**Qualifications \& Experience**

  


* B. Com/M.Com/Pursuing ACCA, CA intermediate with 1\-4 years of relevant accounting experience

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
